newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin signs law imposing 15 pct T-bill tax.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin signs law imposing 15 pct T-bill tax.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin signed a bill into law extending a 15 percent income tax to earnings from operations with government securities, a Kremlin spokesman said on Wednesday.
The bill has already been passed by parliament and will come into force after publication.
Treasury bills and government bonds had previously been exempt from the 15-percent tax on profits from operations with securities.
The amendment is part of a package which also levies a 0.5 percent tax on purchases of foreign currency cash which will primarily affect individual Russians buying dollars at exchange kiosks.
The legislation is part of a package adopted to fund the 1997 budget.
